fuente: CubeSat 101 (NASA CSLI): unit-based format (1U ≈ 10×10×10 cm) with mass limited per unit. A 3U is about 4 kg.

lanzamiento_relay.explicacion: The small rocket that lifts the relay also burns LH2 and LOX: fuel you won't have for the trip home.

requisitos.texto: Needs a radio: without it there's no link to Earth.
Needs an onboard computer to run the radio.
Needs a battery: in the orbit's shadow the panels don't generate.
Needs at least one solar panel to recharge the battery.

piezas.desc: Generates power when the Sun hits it.
Stores power for the shadowed part of the orbit.
Transmits to Earth. It uses the most power.
Controls the satellite and the radio.
Reinforcement: survives launch, but it's heavy.
